model: root-stabilizer canonical exterior occupancy of complete radius-one coronas, followed by exact fixed-boundary radius-two continuation

radius2_to_radius3_unlearned.warning: The traversal prefixes are strongly order-biased; a known radius-three witness proves that extendable radius-two states exist.

radius3_to_radius4_learned.warning: A separately verified radius-four corona exists, so this is a search-order stress result rather than an obstruction.

transfer_ablation.conclusion: Blindly preloading shallow clauses did not change the radius-four search path and added overhead, so it is not enabled by default. On-demand boundary continuation and conflict extraction remain the useful mechanism.

deep_proposal_ablation.policy: bounded direct search at the next radius; a witness jumps forward, while an incomplete run may transfer only sound learned clauses before ordinary outer-state continuation

radius4_to_radius5_equal_wall_budget.conclusion: The deep proposal solves the held-out radius-four ordering failure but does not improve the equal-budget radius-five screen, so it remains optional rather than becoming the default policy.

adaptive_250ms_profile.policy: try the deeper radius for at most 250 ms; jump on success, otherwise fall back with sound clauses
adaptive_250ms_profile.conclusion: The adaptive cap retains the radius-four escape while bounding lost radius-five coverage to 1.8 percent; it remains an explicit profile because it still does not improve radius-five search.

symmetry_nogood_ablation.model: coherently transform whole placement clauses under the proper root stabilizer
symmetry_nogood_ablation.conclusion: Symmetry closure is exact but redundant on this search path, so it is available for controlled experiments and disabled by default.

algorithm_change: The continuation portfolio now canonicalizes completed outer-corona exterior occupancy under the root stabilizer and memoizes obstructed boundary states across solutions and seeds. Exact placement clauses are still learned whenever an obstruction explanation is available.
conclusion: Whole-corona boundary states are much more discriminating than the six individual contact types: 1922 of 2522 distinct sampled radius-one states are exact radius-two obstructions. At deeper levels, on-demand clauses redirect radius-two search toward survivors, while radius-three search still remains trapped in a large dead basin despite a known radius-four witness. The surviving states and sampled censuses leave the tiling classification unresolved.
warning: A sampled boundary-state survival rate is neither a non-tiling certificate nor evidence of aperiodicity.
